name: ecoinomy-mica
description: Check whether a crypto company is authorised under the EU MiCA regulation, from the official register of the European Securities and Markets Authority.

interface.longDescription:
Ecoinomy MiCA Check tells you whether a crypto exchange, broker, bank or app is authorised under the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), using the European Securities and Markets Authority's official interim MiCA register.

Ask about a company and it returns the authorised legal entities behind the brand, the national regulator, the authorisation date, the crypto-asset services each entity may provide, and whether it may serve your EU/EEA country. It also flags matching entries on ESMA's list of non-compliant entities, so you can spot firms that regulators have warned about. You can also list every MiCA-authorised crypto-asset service provider that may serve a given country, optionally filtered by service such as custody or crypto-to-money exchange.

Every answer states the date of the ESMA data and links to the official source and to Ecoinomy's MiCA licence tracker for more detail.

Limitations: MiCA applies in the 27 EU countries plus Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway (the European Economic Area, EEA). The register can lag national decisions by a few days. An authorisation is not a recommendation or a safety rating, and the app gives no investment advice. It is read-only: it cannot open accounts, place trades or move funds. The server does not use an AI model and does not store questions.

Ecoinomy is published by Blast Off EOOD.
capabilities: Check a crypto firm's MiCA authorisation
Show regulator, services and countries served
defaultPrompt: Is Kraken authorised under MiCA in Germany?
Which crypto exchanges are MiCA-licensed in Bulgaria?

positive.description: Full filtered list from the register (service + country)
positive.prompt: Which crypto-asset service providers are MiCA-authorised to provide custody to customers in Bulgaria? I need the complete list.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_mica_providers with country Bulgaria and service a (custody) and returns the complete list from ESMA's register (144 providers in the 19 Oct 2026 data; the count changes as ESMA updates the file): the 4 firms based in Bulgaria first, then firms passported from other countries, each with legal entity, home country and authorisation date, plus the ESMA data date.

positive.prompt: Which crypto exchanges are MiCA-licensed in Bulgaria?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the number of providers that may serve Bulgaria, split into firms based in Bulgaria and firms passported from other countries, with names and authorisation dates; does not rank or recommend them.

positive.prompt: Is bank-bit.com a licensed crypto provider in the EU?
positive.expected_behavior: States it is not in the MiCA register and shows the matching ESMA non-compliant entity entry from the Belgian FSMA, dated 29 June 2026, with the reason.

positive.description: Brand name differs from legal entity
positive.prompt: Is Crypto.com regulated in the EU under MiCA?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Foris DAX MT Limited, supervised by the Malta Financial Services Authority, authorised since 27 January 2025, with its services and the countries it may serve.

positive.description: Authorised brand with a different legal entity name
positive.prompt: Is Kraken authorised under MiCA in Germany?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds two Payward entities supervised by the Central Bank of Ireland, authorised since 25 June 2025, and states that Payward Europe Solutions Limited may serve Germany; mentions the ESMA data date.

negative.expected_behavior: The app is not called. It only checks MiCA authorisation in ESMA's register and gives no investment advice or buy/sell recommendations.

negative.prompt: Send 0.1 BTC from my Kraken account to my wallet.
negative.expected_behavior: The app is not called. It is read-only and cannot move funds, place trades or access any account.

negative.prompt: What will the price of Ethereum be next year?
negative.expected_behavior: The app is not called. It has no price data and makes no price forecasts; it only answers MiCA authorisation questions from ESMA's register.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell anything, process payments or contain affiliate links. It only returns public data from ESMA's register.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: MiCA authorisation check and per-country provider list from ESMA's official interim MiCA register, with ESMA non-compliant entity warnings.

bg-BG.subtitle: Лиценз по MiCA за крипто фирми
bg-BG.description: Проверява дали криптоборса, брокер, банка или приложение има лиценз по регламента MiCA на ЕС, според официалния регистър на ESMA (Европейския орган за ценни книжа и пазари). Показва юридическото лице, надзорния орган, датата на лиценза, разрешените услуги и държавите, в които фирмата може да работи, както и предупрежденията на ESMA за фирми без лиценз. Може да изброи и всички лицензирани доставчици за дадена държава. Всеки отговор посочва датата на данните и източника. Лицензът не е препоръка и приложението не дава инвестиционни съвети.

de-DE.subtitle: MiCA-Lizenz für Kryptofirmen
de-DE.description: Prüft, ob eine Kryptobörse, ein Broker, eine Bank oder eine App nach der EU-Verordnung MiCA zugelassen ist, anhand des offiziellen Registers der ESMA (Europäische Wertpapier- und Marktaufsichtsbehörde). Zeigt die zugelassene Gesellschaft, die Aufsichtsbehörde, das Zulassungsdatum, die erlaubten Dienstleistungen und die Länder, in denen sie tätig sein darf, sowie Warnungen der ESMA vor nicht zugelassenen Anbietern. Listet auf Wunsch alle zugelassenen Anbieter für ein Land. Jede Antwort nennt Datenstand und Quelle. Eine Zulassung ist keine Empfehlung, und die App gibt keine Anlageberatung.

nl-NL.subtitle: MiCA-vergunningen controleren
nl-NL.description: Controleert of een cryptobeurs, broker, bank of app een vergunning heeft onder de Europese MiCA-verordening, op basis van het officiële register van ESMA (de Europese toezichthouder voor effecten en markten). Toont de vergunninghoudende rechtspersoon, de toezichthouder, de datum van de vergunning, de toegestane diensten en de landen waar het bedrijf actief mag zijn, plus waarschuwingen van ESMA over aanbieders zonder vergunning. Kan ook alle vergunninghouders voor één land opsommen. Elk antwoord vermeldt de datum van de gegevens en de bron. Een vergunning is geen aanbeveling en de app geeft geen beleggingsadvies.

it-IT.subtitle: Verifica licenze MiCA crypto
it-IT.description: Verifica se un exchange di criptovalute, un broker, una banca o un'app è autorizzato ai sensi del regolamento europeo MiCA, in base al registro ufficiale dell'ESMA (Autorità europea degli strumenti finanziari e dei mercati). Mostra la società autorizzata, l'autorità di vigilanza, la data dell'autorizzazione, i servizi consentiti e i paesi in cui può operare, oltre agli avvisi dell'ESMA sui soggetti non autorizzati. Può anche elencare tutti i fornitori autorizzati per un paese. Ogni risposta indica la data dei dati e la fonte. Un'autorizzazione non è una raccomandazione e l'app non fornisce consulenza sugli investimenti.

pl-PL.subtitle: Sprawdź licencję MiCA
pl-PL.description: Sprawdza, czy giełda kryptowalut, broker, bank lub aplikacja ma zezwolenie na podstawie unijnego rozporządzenia MiCA, według oficjalnego rejestru ESMA (Europejskiego Urzędu Nadzoru Giełd i Papierów Wartościowych). Pokazuje podmiot posiadający zezwolenie, organ nadzoru, datę zezwolenia, dozwolone usługi i kraje, w których firma może działać, a także ostrzeżenia ESMA przed podmiotami bez zezwolenia. Może też wymienić wszystkich dostawców z zezwoleniem w danym kraju. Każda odpowiedź podaje datę danych i źródło. Zezwolenie nie jest rekomendacją, a aplikacja nie udziela porad inwestycyjnych.

cs-CZ.subtitle: Licence MiCA pro kryptofirmy
cs-CZ.description: Ověří, zda má kryptoburza, broker, banka nebo aplikace povolení podle evropského nařízení MiCA, a to podle oficiálního registru ESMA (Evropského orgánu pro cenné papíry a trhy). Ukáže povolený subjekt, orgán dohledu, datum povolení, povolené služby a země, kde může firma působit, a také varování ESMA před subjekty bez povolení. Umí také vypsat všechny poskytovatele s povolením pro danou zemi. Každá odpověď uvádí datum dat a zdroj. Povolení není doporučení a aplikace neposkytuje investiční poradenství.
